read: 2026-10-18, by eye from the schematic in the Revolution Deux post
comment: Traced by Gottfried Divos (AnalogGuru) and modified by Monkeyxx with information from Sinner and loylo on freestompboxes.org; the image is the corrected version. Component numbering follows the original PCB. The vero layout is by Monkeyxx.
uncertain: C5 could not be measured; the drawing says it should be 47pF and is known to be below 100pF.
VR1 and VR2 are unmarked SMD trimmers on the original, probably 50K and 10K.
rows: VR1, set Q1 collector to 1.35V; unmarked SMD, probably 50K
VR2, set Q2 collector to 5.75V; unmarked SMD, probably 10K
